digest.component_or_area: config sources and resolvers module structure
propositions: _config_sources.py at 791 LOC is inside the 800-LOC cap but in the near-cap warning band, blocking future config changes without breaking CI.

The file already draws a concern boundary between raw-input resolution (lines 31-361) and RP-04 below-seam owned resolvers (lines 364-791), marked by in-file banner comments for tickets d074, 9515, 1b07, and reconciler JIRA family.

The call graph between the two halves is one-directional and narrow: no raw-input symbol names a resolver; exactly one resolver (_snapshot_table) reaches back into the raw-input half via lazy in-body module import to preserve monkeypatch binding semantics.

Splitting into _config_sources.py (403 LOC) and _config_resolvers.py (480 LOC) leaves both files with real headroom under the 800-LOC cap and provides a stable import surface through re-exports without breaking any observable behaviour.
